scripts.dev: npm run build -w @feed-chain/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @feed-chain/server" "npm run dev -w @feed-chain/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @feed-chain/shared && npm run build -w @feed-chain/server && npm run build -w @feed-chain/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @feed-chain/shared && vitest run tests/rules
